preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is an integer between 1 and 80000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid node range [1, n].
The input contains exactly n - 1 edges, forming a tree.
The edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree).

postconditions.description: The output is the count of unordered pairs of paths (a, b) and (c, d) where 1 ≤ a < b ≤ n, 1 ≤ c < d ≤ n, and the shortest paths from a to b and from c to d share no common nodes.

postconditions.expression: count_non_overlapping_path_pairs(edges, n) == sum(1 for a in range(1, n + 1) for b in range(a + 1, n + 1) for c in range(1, n + 1) for d in range(c + 1, n + 1) if not set(get_path_nodes(edges, a, b)).intersection(get_path_nodes(edges, c, d)))
postconditions.description: The count is computed by enumerating all valid pairs of paths (a, b) and (c, d) where a < b, c < d, and their node sets are disjoint.
